benchmark_title: Phase 4: Independent Physical In-Situ ARGO Collocation Benchmark
quality_control: WMO TEMP_QC flags 1 and 2 retained; strictly verified CTD soundings

climatology_woa.description: Parameter-fitted analytical regional profile matching WOA2018/INCOIS NIO baseline

baseline_model.metric_averaging_note: overall_rmse and overall_mae represent pooled sounding-level metrics (N=990 observations across 66 profiles). depth_macro_rmse represents unweighted RMS average over the 15 depth tiers.

physics_constrained_oceanembed.metric_averaging_note: overall_rmse and overall_mae represent pooled sounding-level metrics (N=990 observations across 66 profiles). depth_macro_rmse represents unweighted RMS average over the 15 depth tiers.

rmse_difference_deg_c.definition: Delta_RMSE_i = Baseline_RMSE_i - Physics_RMSE_i (positive = Physics lower error)

mae_difference_deg_c.definition: Delta_MAE_i = Baseline_MAE_i - Physics_MAE_i (positive = Physics lower error)

data_provenance.variable_used: TEMP and PRES with TEMP_QC in (1, 2)
data_provenance.adjusted_variable_check: TEMP_ADJUSTED evaluated across 324,019 levels; identical to TEMP (max diff = 0.000000 C)
data_provenance.reanalysis_assimilation_note: GLORYS12V1 assimilates available ARGO profiles. Phase 4 provides independent validation against direct raw ungridded ARGO profiles with zero direct pipeline leakage, but the training target incorporates indirect ARGO observations.

dataset_provenance.sample_description: 66 ARGO profiles from 52 unique WMO float platforms
